{{short description|Hungarian physicist|bot=PearBOT 5}}
'''Zsolt Bor''' (born 1949) is a Hungarian [[physicist]], currently working at the [[University of Szeged]]. He has a BSc in electrical engineering from the Technical University in Kiev (1973), an MSc in physics (1974), and PhD in physics  from JATE University (1975). He is a member of the [[Academia Europaea]], the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]], the Quantum Electronics and Optics Division of the [[European Physical Society]], the Commission on [[Quantum Electronics]], and Hungarian Physical Society<ref name="urlBor, Zsolt">{{Cite web|url=http://titan.physx.u-szeged.hu/~opthome/optics/honlap/bor.html|title=CV of Zsolt Bor|access-date=2008-11-06}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=klock.design |date=2021-09-09 |title=Dr. Bor Zsolt |url=https://www.primaprimissima.hu/dr-bor-zsolt/ |access-date=2024-10-15 |website=Prima Primissima |language=en-US}}</ref> Department of Optics and Quantum Electronics. He is one of the inventors of the ''Rhinolight phototherapeutical apparatus''<ref name="urlRhinolight - For Patients">{{Cite web|url=http://www.rhinolight.info/ |title=Rhinolight - For Patients|access-date=2008-11-06}}</ref> for [[hay fever]] therapy.
